Ordinance

BE IT ORDAINED BY THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CHICAGO

Section 1. Title 17 of the Municipal Code of Chicago, the Chicago Zoning
Ordinance, is hereby amended by the changing all of the B1-2 Neighborhood
Shopping District symbols and indications as shown on Map No. 16-G in the area
bound by:

A line 197 feet north of and parallel to West Marquette Road; South Halsted Street;
a line 172 feet north of and parallel to West Marquette Road; and the public alley
next west of and parallel to South Halsted Street.

to those of C1-1 Neighborhood Commercial District.

Section 2. This ordinance shall be in force and effect from and after its passage and
due publication.

Common Address of Property: 6640 South Halsted Street, Chicago, Illinois.
